summary.text: Michele Ediger is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 74 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mike King.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former business woman, office manager and banker with experience in real estate, and listed reducing property taxes, fully funding public education and regulating data centers as her key messages.

paragraphs.text: Michele Ediger graduated from Newton High School and attended Hutchinson Community College and Fresno City College.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she called herself a Kansas native, wife, mother, grandmother and Christian, and said she is passionate about making the cost of living affordable for Kansans.
